asset: Blender trees for the pbr look: oak (willow oak), pine (loblolly), magnolia, myrtle (crape myrtle), dogwood, street (red maple). Each GLB holds tree:<species>:<0..2>: a branching trunk with root flare (moss near the ground on oak, dogwood and maple) and leaf cards.
tool: Blender 5.2.3 LTS, headless (blender -b -P), glTF 2.0 exporter with Draco
source: scripts/blender/pbr_trees.py. Branches are seeded random tubes, leaves are quads. No library, scan, photo, or generated model is in it.
prompt: None. The script is the full recipe; run it again to rebuild the files.
credits: Original work for this project. No third-party art. No paid generation credits.
format: GLB, Draco, no materials or textures. COLOR_0 linear vertex color (bark, moss, leaf color with baked crown occlusion), _SWAY (wind weight) and _LEAF custom attributes, crown-facing normals on the leaf cards. _LEAF is [u, v, code]: leaf cards carry the species leaf shape (src/render/leaf-cut.js LEAF_SHAPE_OF), bark carries -1 - bark kind; the shader draws the leaf outline and bark pattern, so no texture is downloaded.
nodes: tree_<species>_<variant>; GLTFLoader drops ':' so geo-view glbTreeTemplates() maps them to tree:<species>:<variant>. Far trees are impostors baked from these models in the browser at load (src/render/tree-impostors.js), not stored in the files.
